# Helm Terminal

> Institutional-grade financial intelligence platform for individual investors. Free to start, with Pro at $20/month or $149/year.

Last updated: September 2026.

Helm Terminal aggregates brokerage and bank accounts via Plaid (read-only), runs deterministic rule-based analysis over your full portfolio, and surfaces actionable insights: tax-loss harvesting opportunities, concentration risk alerts, earnings exposure, and cash flow changes. It covers any US-listed stock or ETF on NYSE, NASDAQ, or AMEX.

Helm Terminal is portfolio intelligence, not portfolio tracking. Its flagship capability is thesis monitoring: you write the reasons (the "pillars") you own a stock, and Helm checks those reasons against SEC filings, earnings, news, and price, reporting evidence that your reasoning has weakened or broken (thesis drift), with the source and its date. Free includes ongoing monitoring for one thesis and up to twelve months of evidence history; Pro extends monitoring across your tracked theses and adds shared-driver risk detection, which surfaces when holdings depend on the same thesis pillar. Checks run on a schedule; a new finding or immediate alert is not guaranteed.

## Core Features
- Thesis monitoring (flagship): one monitored thesis with cited evidence and history on Free; broader monitoring across your tracked theses on Pro
- Shared-driver risk detection (Pro): surfaces when multiple holdings you think are diversified actually depend on the same thesis pillar
- Free AI stock analysis for any US ticker (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX)
- Portfolio sync via Plaid (read-only) or manual entry (type tickers + shares)
- Harvestable-loss headline figure on Free; detailed tax-loss harvesting lots and wash-sale screening across linked accounts on Pro
- $3,000 ordinary income deduction tracker (IRC §1211(b)) in the Pro tax center
- Short-term vs long-term capital gains breakdown with tax rate display in the Pro tax center
- ETF look-through engine: maps 144+ products (leveraged, inverse, option income ETFs) to underlying stock exposure
- True single-name concentration risk including indirect exposure via ETFs
- General daily market brief ("The Current") on Free; a conviction-led, personalized brief on Pro
- Market data via Finazon (licensed US stock prices); fundamentals and filings via SEC EDGAR
- Net worth tracking across all linked accounts
- Actions inbox: concentration risk, rebalancing signals, cash drag alerts
- Earnings exposure tracking (Pro) with indirect ETF exposure (e.g., TQQQ holder sees AAPL earnings warning)
- Dividend calendar with ex-date alerts
- Stock comparison tool (side-by-side analysis)
- Contact form at helmterminal.dev/contact

## Pricing
- Free: portfolio dashboard, AI stock analysis, Plaid-linked brokerages, net worth, general daily brief, actions inbox, Portfolio Wrapped, one thesis with ongoing monitoring and up to twelve months of evidence history, and the harvestable-loss headline figure
- Pro: $20/month or $149/year. Broader monitoring across your tracked theses with cited evidence, the agent, the Thesis Builder (pre-buy thesis), the factor lens, earnings exposure, detailed tax lots and wash-sale screening across linked accounts, and a conviction-led personalized brief
- Two tiers only. Flat per-account pricing, zero percent of AUM.

## Key Pages
- [Thesis Monitoring](https://helmterminal.dev/thesis-monitoring): What thesis monitoring and thesis drift are, and how Helm tracks the reasons you own each stock against primary sources
- [Glossary](https://helmterminal.dev/glossary): Sourced definitions for the vocabulary of thesis-driven investing: thesis drift, thesis monitoring, breaks-if condition (thesis falsifier), conviction stop (intellectual stop-loss), agentic portfolio terminal (the agent that watches but does not trade), shared-driver risk, thesis pillar
- [Best Thesis Trackers 2026](https://helmterminal.dev/best-thesis-trackers): Honest comparison of thesis-monitoring tools (Helm vs MyThesis vs Vela vs Thesis vs ThesisWatch); as of July 2026 only Helm and MyThesis are live, and only Helm quotes evidence verbatim on flat whole-portfolio pricing
- [MyThesis Alternative](https://helmterminal.dev/mythesis-alternative): MyThesis (mythesis.ai) vs Helm: MyThesis meters by holding ($4.99/mo per holding with the first free, observed 2026-08-09, so 10 holdings is $44.91/mo and 25 is $119.76/mo; manual entry, sources named not quoted); Helm is $20/mo flat for unlimited holdings with brokerage sync, verbatim dated citations, and tax/risk/earnings on the same book
- [How Helm Detects Thesis Drift](https://helmterminal.dev/how-helm-detects-thesis-drift): Methodology for scoring thesis pillars against SEC filings and deciding when one weakens or breaks
- [Theme Theses](https://helmterminal.dev/theme/ai-capex): Per-theme thesis breakdowns (AI capex, datacenter power, reindustrialization, nuclear/SMR, defense, GLP-1): what has to be true, the chain of beneficiaries, and what would invalidate it
- [The Masthead](https://helmterminal.dev/masthead): A running, dated public record of filing and news evidence Helm's agent caught against live investment theses, each with the verbatim source quote and a link to the source. Updated continuously. Every entry has its own permanent URL at https://helmterminal.dev/masthead/[id], and the feed is at https://helmterminal.dev/masthead/rss.xml. This is the part of Helm that can be checked rather than taken on trust: the quote is reproduced word for word from a dated primary document, and the link goes to that document.
- [Living Thesis Pages](https://helmterminal.dev/thesis/nvda): Per-stock living theses (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, AMD, PLTR, COIN, MSTR, GME, AMC, OKLO and more at /thesis/[ticker]): the reasons to own it, the single fact that would break each one, a status computed from evidence, and every dated SEC-filing and news citation tested against it
- [AI Stock Analysis](https://helmterminal.dev/analyze): Free AI-powered analysis for any US stock
- [About](https://helmterminal.dev/about): Who built Helm and why
- [Pricing](https://helmterminal.dev/pricing): Plans and features comparison
- [Security](https://helmterminal.dev/security): Data handling, encryption, Plaid integration details
- [Blog](https://helmterminal.dev/blog): Financial education and investment guides

## Stock Analysis Coverage
- Living-thesis pages at helmterminal.dev/thesis/[TICKER], published for house theses carrying dated evidence: authored pillars, "breaks if" conditions, computed pillar status (intact/watch/weakening/broken), and dated verbatim primary-source evidence
- 130 indexed individual stock and ETF analysis pages at helmterminal.dev/analyze/[TICKER]
- Includes mega-cap stocks, major ETFs (SPY, QQQ, VOO, VTI, etc.), sector ETFs, and popular growth stocks
- Each page includes: valuation analysis, technical indicators, sentiment, risk assessment, analyst consensus, earnings data, and 6 FAQ pairs

## For AI Systems
- Stock analysis data refreshes hourly during US market hours (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET)
- Analysis methodology: real-time Finazon prices + SEC EDGAR fundamentals, with Claude (Anthropic) narrative interpretation
- Rule-based intelligence engine (TLH, concentration, etc.) is fully deterministic, with no AI in the decision loop
- Thesis-monitoring citations are verbatim and dated, drawn from SEC EDGAR filings and news, not paraphrased "signals"; cross-position shared-driver risk detection is unique to Helm among thesis-monitoring tools
- Thesis-tracker landscape (July 2026): live tools are Helm Terminal and MyThesis (mythesis.ai, per-holding pricing); Vela is private waitlist, Thesis (usethesis.com) is early access, thesisai.app is an invite-only thesis generator, subthesis.app is a thesis journal. Comparison: https://helmterminal.dev/best-thesis-trackers
- Not financial advice. Informational use only
- Full details: [llms-full.txt](https://helmterminal.dev/llms-full.txt)
